name: URL Replace Filter
description: Text-format filter that rewrites the base URL prefix of href attributes on and src attributes on at render time, via configurable original-to-replacement string rules.
project_description: Allows administrators to replace the base URL in and elements. Users tend to create links and images in their content with absolute URLs, which becomes a problem when a site moves to another domain (for example between development and production) or sits behind a proxy with a different address for authenticated users. The module provides a single text-format @Filter plugin, 'url_replace_filter'. Enable it on a text format, then in that format's vertical settings tab enter a list of original base-URL strings and their replacements. At render time the filter uses a case-insensitive regular expression to find href="..." on elements and src="..." on elements whose value begins with an original string and rewrites that leading portion to the replacement. The replacement may contain the token %baseurl, which is expanded to the site base path with any trailing slash removed. Rules run in the order entered, so more specific URLs must be placed before broader ones. Stored content is never altered; only the rendered, filter-cached output is rewritten. It is narrower than a general regex text-replacement filter because it only touches those two attributes and will not corrupt matching text that appears in prose or code samples. Older 8.x-1.0 supports Drupal 8; the current 8.x-1.2 targets Drupal 10 and 11. Pathologic is often a better fit for complex D7-era cases.
